display.purpose: Masthead wordmark and homepage hero only.

headline.purpose: Page titles, opened by a 2px ink rule.

title.purpose: Section heads and ledger-row item titles.

body-serif.purpose: Article full text and ledes at 44-52.5rem measures, line-height 1.7.

label.purpose: Datelines, metadata labels, chips, nav strip; 11px (--text-2xs) is the absolute floor.

shadows.name: ring-focus
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring (paired with primary border).

motion.name: transition-slow
motion.purpose: Larger reveals; ceiling. No bounce, no elastic.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: The default control: outlined, flat, ink-on-transparent. Loudness opts in elsewhere.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: var(--space-sm, 0.5rem) var(--space-lg, 1.5rem); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.9375rem); font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #13161c); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ced1d6); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.5rem); box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-sunken, #f4f1ef); border-color: var(--border-strong, #aeb1b7); color: var(--ink-strong, #05070c); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-color, #ce4115); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The opt-in loud action (.btn--primary or a submit control): brand fill, glow halo, hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: var(--space-sm, 0.5rem) var(--space-lg, 1.5rem); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.9375rem); font-weight: 500; color: var(--white, #ffffff); background: var(--primary, #ce4115); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 0.5rem); box-shadow: var(--glow-sm, 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(206,65,21,0.25)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #b03710); transform: translateY(-0.0625rem); box-shadow: var(--glow-md, 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(206,65,21,0.3)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--primary-active, #942c0c); transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: var(--glow-xs, 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(206,65,21,0.2)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-color, #ce4115); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Full-width field on paper white; focus swaps the border to primary and adds the 3px ring, no transform.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: var(--space-sm, 0.5rem) var(--space-md, 1rem); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-base, 1.0625rem); color: var(--ink, #13161c); background: var(--panel-bg, #fdfcfb); border: 1px solid var(--border, #ced1d6); border-radius: var(--panel-radius, 0.5rem); line-height: 1.4; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #ce4115); box-shadow: var(--ring-focus, 0 0 0 3px rgba(206,65,21,0.3)); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #66696e); }

components.name: Type Chip
components.description: Outlined uppercase pill with a categorical dot — category is a dot, never a fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #aeb1b7); border-radius: var(--radius-full, 9999px); color: var(--ink-light, #3f4349); font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-xs, 0.8125rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide, 0.04em); padding: 2px var(--space-3, 0.75rem); transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--ink-strong, #05070c); border-color: var(--ink-strong, #05070c); } .ds-chip-dot { width: 0.5em; height: 0.5em; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--type-article, #ce4115); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Dateline
components.description: The recurring identity device: TYPE · PUBLISHER · DATE in tracked uppercase with primary interpuncts.
components.css: .ds-dateline { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5em; margin: 0; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs, 0.6875rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider, 0.08em); color: var(--muted, #66696e); } .ds-dateline-sep { color: var(--primary, #ce4115); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: The result-list unit: hairline-ruled row with dateline eyebrow, Besley title, snippet. No box, no shadow, no lift.
components.html:
Article·La Croix du Bénin·4 June 1993

Le pèlerinage à La Mecque des musulmans béninois

Les préparatifs du hajj mobilisent cette année plus de trois cents fidèles, encadrés par la communauté…
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light, #e2e5e8); background: transparent; } .ds-ledger-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 0.375rem; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs, 0.6875rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider, 0.08em); color: var(--muted, #66696e); } .ds-ledger-sep { color: var(--primary, #ce4115); padding: 0 0.4em; } .ds-ledger-title { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-family: Besley, 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-xl, 1.5rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display, -0.01em); color: var(--ink, #13161c); } .ds-ledger-snippet { margin: 0; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-sm, 0.9375rem); line-height: 1.5; color: var(--ink-light, #3f4349); display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

components.name: Almanac Figure
components.description: KPI as an almanac entry: 2px ink rule, uppercase eyebrow, Besley numeral with lining figures. No card, no gradient.
components.css: .ds-almanac { border-top: 2px solid var(--ink-strong, #05070c); padding-top: 0.625rem; background: transparent; } .ds-almanac-label { margin: 0 0 0.25rem; font-family: 'Public Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs, 0.6875rem); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider, 0.08em); color: var(--muted, #66696e); } .ds-almanac-figure { margin: 0; font-family: Besley, 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-2xl, 1.875rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: var(--tracking-display, -0.01em); font-feature-settings: 'lnum'; color: var(--ink, #13161c); }

narrative.overview: A 20th-century broadsheet operated as a scientific instrument. The site is a scholarly database — LLM sentiment models, LDA topics, embeddings, IIIF — that carries the visual grammar of the newspapers it preserves: masthead wordmark, uppercase section strip, thick 2px ink rules, datelines, ledger-style result rows, a duotone press-collage hero. The execution is a modern broadsheet's digital archive run by a university press: newspaper typographic conventions with Linear/Stripe-grade product polish. Density is a feature, not a compromise, and restraint is the resting state — the quiet control is the default and loudness opts in.
keyCharacteristics: Newspaper grammar (rules, datelines, ledgers) executed with product-grade polish
Density over comfort; typography as architecture, rules as joinery
Near-white cool-neutral light mode; warm "lamplit reading room" dark mode
One brand accent used sparingly; category encoded as dots, never fills

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: The duotone hero — a grayscale collage multiplied over a primary ground — is the one big color statement on the site. Everything else earns primary only as an accent.

rules.name: The Dot-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Category is a dot on an outlined chip, never a filled or pastel badge. Ten filled badges per screen is shouting; ten dots is an index.

rules.name: The Data-Only Secondary Rule
rules.body: #394f68 exists for charts. If it appears on a button, link, or focus ring, it is a bug.

rules.name: The Slab Tracking Rule
rules.body: Besley display sizes track at -0.01em, never the full -0.02em — slab serifs clog at tight tracking.

rules.name: The Lining Zero Rule
rules.body: Besley's tnum zero is broken (frozen at 55 units across weights); use font-feature-settings 'lnum' for aligned numerals, never tabular-nums with the display serif.

rules.name: The No-14px Rule
rules.body: The type scale deliberately skips 14px; 11px (--text-2xs) is the floor. Absolute font-size literals fail npm run check:tokens — use --text-* tokens.

rules.name: The Glass Once Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-filter belongs to the sticky header and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Rules-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: Before adding a shadowed card, try a 2px ink rule or a hairline. Boxes are a last resort for true panels.

dos: Do open sections with 2px ink rules and divide rows with hairlines — typography is the architecture, rules are the joinery.
Do keep transitions 150–300ms on cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); real objects decelerate smoothly.
Do mark AI-generated fields with the EU "AI GENERATED" provenance treatment.
Do mix colors in oklab, derive primary variants from the seed, and run npm run check:tokens before trusting any token name.
Do test any new font against ḥ ṣ ḍ ṭ ẓ ʿ ā ī ū before adopting it.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus state and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use warm cream or parchment surfaces — wrong register ("manuscript museum brochure").
Don't add atmospheric gradients, gradient bars, glassmorphism (outside the sticky header), or colored side-stripes.
Don't fill category badges or color h2s in primary — category is a dot, primary is an accent.
Don't use cold blue-gray dark surfaces — dark mode is warm ("lamplit"), hue ~70–80.
Don't box result rows into cards or stack decorative effects on one component.
Don't use bouncing/elastic easing or hover-triggered hero animations (the one-time Ken Burns settle is the sanctioned exception).
Don't pair Besley with tabular-nums (broken tnum zero) or track it tighter than -0.01em.
